specs.title: 飞行萝卜
specs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one transparent two-frame animation strip for ONE enemy species in an existing paper rabbit jumping game. Input is the EDIT TARGET and style reference. Preserve the target's identity, palette, black charcoal crayon outlines, textured printed paper interiors and crisp thin cream cutout rim. Change it into a visibly airborne flying enemy: the same mischievous rosy pink round radish imp with cream belly and teal leafy crown. Replace its planted feet/arms pose with a small pair of cream feather-like wings attached naturally to its sides, little feet tucked while hovering. Left frame wings lifted, right frame wings lowered. Overall silhouette width:height 58:52 including wings, crown and tucked feet. Keep radish body prominent and face readable. Composition: a horizontal strip with exactly TWO equal cells, same creature same body scale and same center in both cells, left wings up and right wings down. Empty transparent center gutter and generous transparent outside padding; complete silhouettes without clipped wings. Body itself remains stable, only wing poses change, clear alternating flap. Flat 2D illustration matching the target, alpha zero outside the thin paper rim. NO ground, platforms, background, glow, outer shadow, dust, speed lines, UI, text, labels, watermark or extra characters. True transparent RGBA background.
